description: Escape hatch for any Longhorn API endpoint not covered by a named tool. In --read-only mode, only GET requests succeed — everything else is refused before it reaches Longhorn. GET is always safe to call freely; for POST/PUT/DELETE, treat this exactly like the destructive tools elsewhere in this server — do not call with a mutating method unless the user has explicitly authorized that specific action in this conversation.
name: longhorn_raw_request
title: Raw Longhorn API request
